payload.title: Announcement rules and settings page: what gets announced, opt-in, pause
payload.description:
Part of the scheduled publishing and announcements epic. Design: docs/plans/scheduled-publishing-and-announcements.md ("What triggers an announcement", "The pause switch and opt-in").

Goal: a site owner decides in plain words what is announced and turns announcements on or off; everything is off by default.

Shape: Administration > Announcements: On/Off (off by default; on needs a connected account, the label confirmation and a budget); minimum stars 1 to 5, never below the site's quality floor (PPY-0e8d66), default 5; Story types (Article, Post); optional sections; approval required or automatic; "Pause announcements" at the top with reason and who paused; eligible but blocked Stories listed with their reason. Same settings through the operation table. Lucide icons, flat fills, no borders.

Depends on: the channel framework story. Relates to PPY-0e8d66.

```gherkin
Feature: The site owner decides what is announced
  Announcing is the most public thing a site does, so it is off until the owner
  turns it on, and the owner sets the bar.

  Scenario: Off until turned on
    Given a site that never turned announcements on
    When a 5-star Article is published
    Then nothing is posted

  Scenario: Only 5 stars on MoM
    Given MoM announces Articles rated 5 stars
    When a 4-star Article is published
    Then it is not announced
    And it is not listed as waiting

  Scenario: The floor cannot go below the site's quality floor
    Given the site's quality floor is 3 stars
    When the owner tries to set the announcement minimum to 2 stars
    Then the page says "Announcements can't go below your quality floor of 3 stars."

  Scenario: Unrated and predicted are never enough
    Given an unrated Article that the model predicts editors will love
    When it is published
    Then it is not announced

  Scenario: Pausing stops everything and shows why
    When Ryan chooses "Pause announcements"
    Then the page says "Paused by Ryan, 13 Nov 10:02"
    And a 5-star Article published while paused waits as "Blocked: paused"
    And resuming posts it

  Scenario: Limiting to sections
    Given MoM announces only the Security section
    When a 5-star Article in Hardware is published
    Then it is not announced
```

Open questions: whether References (accepted research) should ever be announced (recommend not now).
